description: Apply and remove labels on one thread, or one message of it - an Outlook mailbox's categories are its labels. The ids come from labels_list. Adding SPAM junks it, and taking SPAM off brings it back to the inbox. In a Gmail mailbox adding TRASH bins it too; an Outlook mailbox takes UNREAD and STARRED beside its categories and SPAM, and no other id; a mailbox whose provider is imap takes only UNREAD, STARRED, SPAM and its folders' labels, one folder a call: adding a folder's label moves the inbox messages into it and removing it moves its messages back to the inbox, each message moved taking a new id, which the answer names.

id.description: The threadId a search or a read answered, or with scope message the message's id.

mailbox.description: The mailbox's name or its email address.

scope.description: thread, the default, acts on the whole thread; message acts on that one message alone.

name: threads_modify
title: Label a thread
